news.title: Google delayed Gemini 3.5 Pro after coding and reasoning fell short
news.summary: Google's flagship Gemini 3.5 Pro is months behind schedule after internal testing showed weak coding and complex-reasoning results, keeping it in limited partner testing while OpenAI and Anthropic ship stronger models, according to reports this week.

news.title: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 topped the Frontend Code Arena as the largest open-weight model yet
news.summary: China's Moonshot AI unveiled Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that debuted at #1 on the Frontend Code Arena ahead of Claude Fable 5, with API access live now and full open weights slated for July 27.

news.title: Apple briefly overtook Nvidia as the world's most valuable company
news.summary: Apple momentarily passed Nvidia in market value on July 17 as investors rotated toward Apple's AI plans, with both companies hovering near $4.9 trillion before Nvidia closed narrowly ahead.

news.title: Google's AI Mode added Instacart, Canva, and YouTube Music for in-chat task completion
news.summary: Google began rolling out Connected Apps in AI Mode for US users, letting people build Instacart carts, get Canva template suggestions, and generate YouTube Music playlists without leaving a search conversation.

news.title: Fireworks AI raised a $1.5B Series D at a $17.5B valuation
news.summary: Inference-infrastructure startup Fireworks closed a $1.5 billion Series D led by Atreides, Index Ventures, and TCV at a $17.5 billion valuation, having crossed $1 billion in annualized revenue as enterprises chase cheaper model serving.

news.title: Microsoft is prepping 'Project Perception,' a multi-model AI security tool
news.summary: Microsoft is reportedly readying Project Perception, a cybersecurity product that routes vulnerability-finding and remediation across models from Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic to undercut the cost of Anthropic's Mythos.

news.title: A Suno breach exposed source code suggesting large-scale scraping of YouTube and others
news.summary: A hacker's leak of Suno's source code and datasets indicated the AI music generator scraped millions of tracks from YouTube Music, Deezer, and Genius, potentially bolstering record labels' copyright suits, per reporting on the breach.

news.title: Meta poached senior AWS executive Dave Brown to build out AI data centers
news.summary: Meta hired nearly two-decade AWS veteran Dave Brown to lead its data-center and compute buildout under infrastructure chief Santosh Janardhan, as the company weighs renting AI capacity to outside customers.

news.title: Apple sent document-preservation letters to about 40 ex-employees now at OpenAI
news.summary: As its trade-secrets suit against OpenAI escalates, Apple sent legal letters to roughly 40 former employees now at OpenAI, ordering them to preserve documents and warning against deleting potential evidence.

news.title: San Francisco ordered Apple and Google to pull AI 'nudify' apps
news.summary: San Francisco City Attorney David Chiu sent cease-and-desist letters demanding Apple and Google remove 13 AI 'nudify' apps that generate nonconsensual explicit images, the first US municipal app-store removal mandate of its kind.

news.title: Monzo co-founder Tom Blomfield left Y Combinator to join Anthropic's compute team
news.summary: Tom Blomfield, Monzo co-founder and a Y Combinator general partner, said he is taking leave from YC to join Anthropic's compute team under Chief Compute Officer Tom Brown, part of a broader Anthropic hiring run.

news.title: UK's Humanoid became a unicorn with a $150M first-tranche Series A
news.summary: London-based Humanoid raised $150 million in the first tranche of a Series A at a $1.2 billion valuation and plans to raise $80-100 million more by September to scale general-purpose industrial robots, The Information reported.
